snippet.title: Sonic Unleashed 3DS - Trailer Demo #1
snippet.description:
It finally here let's goooooooooo
Link to download the game (qr code or file) : https://gamejolt.com/games/unleashed-3ds/795748

The trailer is a reference of the first teaser of sonic unleashed (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4PaSW7aUIxo)
Footage are recorded on citra, with x4 native resolution and forceScale texture filter.
Footage have been taken before final product

You want to know more ? Check Sonic Unleashed 3DS on :
Discord : https://discord.com/invite/URysmgnBYt
Gamejolt : https://gamejolt.com/games/unleashed-3ds/795748

Fangame developped by Innovative Development (Ynox)
